message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films you might enjoy:

| # | Title | Year | Director | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|----------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Stanley Kubrick | A masterclass in psychological dread with iconic imagery. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Ari Aster | A chilling family saga that blends supernatural terror with raw emotion. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Jordan Peele | Sharp social commentary wrapped in a smart, suspenseful thriller. |
| 4 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Ari Aster | A daylight horror that turns a pastoral festival into a nightmare. |
| 5 | **It Follows** | 2014 | David Robert Mitchell | An inventive premise where the threat is always on your back. |
| 6 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | John Krasinski | Tension built around silence; a fresh take on survival horror. |
| 7 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Jennifer Kent | Psychological horror that explores grief and motherhood. |
| 8 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | James Wan | A well‑crafted paranormal investigation with strong pacing. |
| 9 | **Suspiria (1977)** | 1977 | Dario Argento | Visually stunning giallo with an unsettling atmosphere. |
|10 | **The Witch** | 2015 | Robert Eggers | Slow‑burn period horror grounded in folklore and dread. |

Feel free to pick based on whether you prefer psychological thrillers, supernatural scares, or something more atmospheric. Happy watching!
